en.quote: Hear this, all ye people; give ear, all ye inhabitants of the world: Both low and high, rich and poor, together. My mouth shall speak of wisdom; and the meditation of my heart shall be of understanding. I will incline mine ear to a parable: I will open my dark saying upon the harp.
en.riddle: I will open my dark saying upon the harp.
en.speaker: Psalmist

bonus_hint.quote: Give ear to my words, O LORD, consider my meditation.

he.quote: לַמְנַצֵּחַ לִבְנֵי־קֹרַח מִזְמֽוֹר שִׁמְעוּ־זֹאת כָּל־הָֽעַמִּים הַאֲזִינוּ כָּל־יֹשְׁבֵי חָֽלֶד גַּם־בְּנֵי אָדָם גַּם־בְּנֵי־אִישׁ יַחַד עָשִׁיר וְאֶבְיֽוֹן פִּי יְדַבֵּר חָכְמוֹת וְהָגוּת לִבִּי תְבוּנֽוֹת
he.riddle: פִּי יְדַבֵּר חָכְמוֹת וְהָגוּת לִבִּי תְבוּנֽוֹת
he.speaker: בְּנֵי קֹרַח

en.1: Hear this, all ye people; give ear, all ye inhabitants of the world:
en.2: Both low and high, rich and poor, together.
en.3: My mouth shall speak of wisdom; and the meditation of my heart shall be of understanding.
en.4: I will incline mine ear to a parable: I will open my dark saying upon the harp.

he.3: גַּם־בְּנֵי אָדָם גַּם־בְּנֵי־אִישׁ יַחַד עָשִׁיר וְאֶבְיֽוֹן׃
he.4: פִּי יְדַבֵּר חָכְמוֹת וְהָגוּת לִבִּי תְבוּנֽוֹת׃
